title: Guava avoids traversal for impossible live-set equality
summary: Both JRE and Android returned false with one backing iterator call on the parent and zero on the fix. Symmetry, same-size mismatches and live equality after backing-set mutation held on both pins.

change.description: Both should return false. The parent implementation predicts at least one call to the wrapped set's iterator, the merge zero for this fixture.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.
Both the JRE and Android library variants run on the same JVM.
